integrity: Proof and standalone verification included; historical linear feasibility and general redundancy bounds are credited as prior art. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary Hamming distance, systematic encoding, message parity, and thresholds 3/5.
Only r>=6 is shown for k>=7; the optimal larger redundancy is not determined.
All mappings are classified only at k=6, r=5.
An unindexed nonlinear equality classification may precede this result.
title: Affine rigidity at the six-bit limit for systematic parity-protecting codes
